defmodule SecureDB.Driver do
  @moduledoc """
  Encrypted database driver with audit notification system.
  Sends email alerts on sensitive operations via SMTP headers.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @encryption_key :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
  @audit_email "security@company.internal"

  defstruct [:conn, :cipher_state, :audit_config]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    conn = establish_connection(opts[:host], opts[:port], opts[:database])
    cipher_state = init_cipher(@encryption_key)
    audit_config = %{
      smtp_host: opts[:smtp_host] || "localhost",
      smtp_port: opts[:smtp_port] || 25,
      from: opts[:audit_from] || "db-driver@company.internal"
    }
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{conn: conn, cipher_state: cipher_state, audit_config: audit_config}}
  end

  def execute_query(query, params, opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:execute, query, params, opts})
  end

  def handle_call({:execute, query, params, opts}, _from, state) do
    encrypted_params = encrypt_sensitive_params(params, state.cipher_state)
    result = do_execute(state.conn, query, encrypted_params)

    if opts[:audit] do
      context = build_audit_context(query, params, opts)
      send_audit_notification(context, state.audit_config)
    end

    {:reply, {:ok, decrypt_result(result, state.cipher_state)}, state}
  end

  defp build_audit_context(query, params, opts) do
    %{
      query_hash: :crypto.hash(:sha256, query) |> Base.encode16(),
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601(),
      operator: opts[:operator] || "system",
      table_name: extract_table_name(query),
      record_count: length(params)
    }
  end

  defp send_audit_notification(context, config) do
    subject = compose_subject(context)
    headers = build_email_headers(context, config, subject)
    body = format_audit_body(context)
    dispatch_smtp(headers, body, config)
  end

  defp compose_subject(context) do
    "[DB Audit] Operation on #{context.table_name} by #{context.operator}"
  end

  defp build_email_headers(context, config, subject) do
    # Build RFC 2822 compliant headers
    base_headers = [
      "From: #{config.from}",
      "To: #{@audit_email}",
      "Subject: #{sanitize_header_value(subject)}",
      "Date: #{context.timestamp}",
      "Message-ID: <#{generate_message_id()}>",
      "X-Audit-Hash: #{context.query_hash}",
      "X-Operator: #{sanitize_header_value(context.operator)}",
      "MIME-Version: 1.0",
      "Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8"
    ]
    Enum.join(base_headers, "\r\n")
  end

  defp sanitize_header_value(value) when is_binary(value) do
    # Strip ALL control characters including CR and LF to prevent header injection
    value
    |> String.replace(~r/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/, "")
    |> truncate_header(998)
  end

  defp truncate_header(value, max_len) do
    if String.length(value) > max_len do
      String.slice(value, 0, max_len)
    else
      value
    end
  end

  defp format_audit_body(context) do
    """
    Database Audit Event
    ====================
    Time: #{context.timestamp}
    Operator: #{context.operator}
    Table: #{context.table_name}
    Query Hash: #{context.query_hash}
    Records Affected: #{context.record_count}
    """
  end

  defp dispatch_smtp(headers, body, config) do
    message = headers <> "\r\n\r\n" <> body
    case :gen_tcp.connect(String.to_charlist(config.smtp_host), config.smtp_port, [:binary, active: false]) do
      {:ok, socket} ->
        :gen_tcp.send(socket, "EHLO #{node()}\r\n")
        :gen_tcp.send(socket, "MAIL FROM:<#{config.from}>\r\n")
        :gen_tcp.send(socket, "RCPT TO:<#{@audit_email}>\r\n")
        :gen_tcp.send(socket, "DATA\r\n")
        :gen_tcp.send(socket, message <> "\r\n.\r\n")
        :gen_tcp.send(socket, "QUIT\r\n")
        :gen_tcp.close(socket)
        :ok
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Audit SMTP failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        :error
    end
  end

  defp encrypt_sensitive_params(params, cipher_state) do
    Enum.map(params, fn
      {key, value} when is_binary(value) ->
        {key, encrypt_value(value, cipher_state)}
      param -> param
    end)
  end

  defp encrypt_value(plaintext, cipher_state) do
    iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16)
    {ciphertext, tag} = :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(:aes_256_gcm, cipher_state, iv, plaintext, "", true)
    iv <> tag <> ciphertext
  end

  defp decrypt_result(result, cipher_state) do
    Enum.map(result, fn row ->
      Enum.map(row, fn
        {key, <<iv::binary-16, tag::binary-16, ciphertext::binary>>} ->
          {key, :crypto.crypto_one_time_aead(:aes_256_gcm, cipher_state, iv, ciphertext, "", tag, false)}
        field -> field
      end)
    end)
  end

  defp init_cipher(key), do: key
  defp establish_connection(_h, _p, _d), do: make_ref()
  defp do_execute(_conn, _q, _p), do: []
  defp extract_table_name(query), do: query |> String.split() |> Enum.at(3, "unknown")
  defp generate_message_id, do: "#{:erlang.unique_integer([:positive])}@#{node()}"
end
